name: ⚔️ Colosseum Catcher
description:
Catch wild beasts, train them and fight your way to the top of the COLOSSEUM LEAGUE!

⚔️ Classic turn-based battles with 10 elements
🔮 Catch 50 original beasts - find a rare PRISMATIC one!
🏛️ Beat 8 arena leaders, the Grand Four and the Champion
📜 Daily quests, achievements and titles
🌪️ Beast swarms, a free Lucky Wheel and a daycare
🔥 Endless Gauntlet: how far can you go?
🤝 Duel your friends for trophies

New beasts every update!
